run_evaluation_on_dataset: run the evaluate function to evaluate a dynamic stereo model on a benchmark dataset like sintel or dynamicreplica
run_eval_with_config: run the run_eval function with a DefaultConfig to evaluate model metrics and save results to JSON
evaluate_dynamicreplica_dataset: run evaluation on the dynamicreplica validation dataset using the Evaluator and model_zoo components
evaluate_real_sequences: run evaluation on real-world sequences like teddy_static or ignacio_waving using DynamicReplicaDataset
configure_evaluation_with_hydra: configure and run the Hydra-based evaluate entry point with custom dataset, model, and GPU settings
